description_en: Changes the scheduled switchover time of an O\&M task
description_zh: 修改运维任务的计划切换时间
name: ModifyActiveOperationTask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the O\&M task. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473865.html operation to query the ID of an O\&M task
parameters.help_zh:
运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473865.html获取运维任务ID
parameters.name: ids

parameters.help_en:
The scheduled switchover time to be specified. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The time cannot be later than the latest operation time. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473865.html operation to obtain the latest operation time, which is the value of the Deadline parameter in the response
parameters.help_zh: 要设置的计划切换时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 不能晚于最晚操作时间，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473865.html，通过返回参数**Deadline**的值来获取最晚操作时间
parameters.name: switch_time

Ids.description_en: The ID of the O\&M task. IDs are separated by commas (,)
Ids.description_zh: 运维任务ID，多个ID间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
